content: The goals of Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) for individuals with diabetes are as follows: 1. Encourage the adoption of healthful eating patterns by promoting the intake of nutrient-dense foods in appropriate portion sizes. This approach aims to enhance overall health, support the achievement of a healthy body weight, and help maintain blood glucose and blood pressure levels within target ranges. 2. Tailor nutritional recommendations to meet the unique needs of each individual. This includes taking into account cultural and personal preferences, health literacy levels, and access to healthy food options. 3. Equip individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary to make informed dietary choices. This empowerment helps improve their confidence in managing their diet effectively. 4. Emphasize the use of practical tools and strategies to foster sustainable and healthy eating habits. Rather than focusing on specific macronutrients or individual foods, the approach prioritizes actionable methods to support long-term dietary improvements.
